title: Unitree unveils an all-terrain robot dog you can no longer outrun
text:
Unitree unveils an all-terrain robot dog you can no longer outrun"

"The AS2-W can travel more than 30km (18.6 miles) unloaded across steep, rocky and uneven terrain — and carry a continuous payload of 16kg (35lb)"
